consequence.statement: The flag `--enable-remote-node-identity` is no longer recognized or honoured in Cilium 1.16.0; any configuration passing this flag will be ignored.
consequence.remediation: Remove the `enable-remote-node-identity` flag from Cilium's configuration and deployment manifests. Consult the Cilium 1.16.0 upgrade notes for recommended alternatives or migration paths if remote node identity configuration is still required.

assertion.statement: The deprecated CLI flag `enable-remote-node-identity` has been removed and is no longer honoured.
